description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Earth], [Awoken Earth], [Damage Cap +10000], [Pulverizing Blow Follow-Up], [Fear Mode] and [Overflow Earth Radiant Shield: 75%] to the user

description.name: Awoken Earth
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Pulverizing Blow Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Pulverizing Blow after using four Earth abilities

description.name: Pulverizing Blow
description.text: One single attack (5.20) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate, grants [Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Fear Mode
description.text: Grants [Overflow Earth Radiant Shield: 125%]/[Overflow Earth Radiant Shield: 200%]/[Overflow Earth Radiant Shield: 300%] after using 1/2/3+ Earth abilities

description.name: Overflow Earth Radiant Shield: 125%
description.text: Returns 125% of the damage taken to the attacker as Earth damage capped at 99999

description.name: Overflow Earth Radiant Shield: 200%
description.text: Returns 200% of the damage taken to the attacker as Earth damage capped at 99999

description.name: Overflow Earth Radiant Shield: 300%
description.text: Returns 300% of the damage taken to the attacker as Earth damage capped at 99999

description.name: Overflow Earth Radiant Shield: 75%
description.text: Returns 75% of the damage taken to the attacker as Earth damage capped at 99999
